candidate_components.I1: Matched-budget coverage/contrast paired observation against UNIFORM
candidate_components.I2: Real complete-query joint teacher guidance versus same-context binary guidance
candidate_components.I3: Reference-centered shared object and local-state prediction with signed interaction

mandatory_ordinary: adequate unrestricted four-class joint KD with complete raw anchor inputs
adequate marginal KD with all same visual inputs and marginalized joint targets
adequate raw/unit and confidence/clipped coarse distillation, fixed early/final mean included
context_reference: Original3 context anchors; preferentially disjoint3 real observation reference pool for teacher and dense-prediction partner. Intrinsic short-track fallback reported, not filtered by labels.
prefix_rule: Past and current video only; no future teacher responses or normalizers; per-video model snapshots saved locally
optimizer_rule: Deterministic seed0; adequate ordinary fit checked against its proper-target entropy floor, additional optimization/capacity only if required by its own training risk; no GT checkpoint/threshold choice
inference_rule: Marginalize joint predictions with fixed same reference-pool partners for every comparable learner; no hard video absence from two No answers
evaluation: All new-study raw and both-count outputs sealed before isolated official GT evaluation; no online GT feedback into adaptation
uncertainty: Original parent video bootstrap at fixed seed0; KITTI4 no population CI; all DEV no independent blind validation
pass_rule: Primary must beat adequate ordinary references across six settings, retained components/interaction attributable with dual CountMatched; no switching to posthoc higher controls; no positive result guarantee
cost_rule: Research union/prepaid features not deployment cost. Actual same-fresh-input quality and full independent cold wall for final retained recipe after quality gate; no cold for rejected previous FULL

common_inputs.trajectory_properties: Aligned-history common image-translation/logsize nuisance cancellation; scene ranks and relative sizes; raw image motion retained. Not camera/world-motion identification.
